B) Wed Mar 24, 13:00 PDT / 21:00 CET / 05:00 JST (next day) — late for APAC again
C) Thu Mar 25, 16:00 PDT / 00:00 CET (Fri) / 08:00 JST — early for APAC, late for EU

If none of these work, propose a CET-morning slot and we’ll route via a shorter overlapping window for APAC. Vivek (cc’d) will run the demo and Mina/Hiro are joining for the regional compliance points.

I’ve attached: redwood-data-flow-diagram.pdf (data flow + pseudonymization callouts) and the milestones matrix you requested.

Please reply with your preferred option and any additional reviewers we should include (procurement, legal, etc.).
